title: A zero neighbourhood for an etale section killed by inverse image
statement: Let $X,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $V\to X$ an etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $a:T\to V$, and $p:T\to X$ satisfy $a$ followed by the structure map of $V$ equals $p$. Let $F$ be an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and let $H$ be any left adjoint to $p_*$, with its supplied adjunction unit [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For $s\in F(V)$ assume its image under the unit $F(V)\to H(F)(V\times_X T)$ followed by restriction along $(a,\mathrm{id}_T):T\to V\times_X T$ is zero. There exists an open subset $U\subseteq V$ containing $a(T)$ such that the restriction of $s$ to the etale object $U\to V\to X$ is zero.

source.place: Definition 59.29.6 (filtered-colimit stalks) in Tag 03PN; Lemma 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback) (3), with unit-germ compatibility

proof.text: For each t in T, use the algebraic closure of its residue field to obtain the geometric point y = T.algClosurePoint t. Put Phi = pointSmallEtale y and Psi = Phi.comap p.Etale. The lift (a,id) gives a pointed object v of Psi over V. Use the proved general-site Point.sheafFiberComapIso and Point.toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberComapIso_hom_app from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Point.Comap directly. Compare the abstract inverse-image adjunction with hH using Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. Germ naturality for this comparison and restriction along (a,id) gives the displayed equality hg in the private helper etaleSection_zero_pointed_witness. The composite comparison is invertible. Since the restricted unit section is zero, its source germ is zero. This realizes the unit-compatible stalk argument of Stacks 03Q1 without importing the specialized Etale.upperStar-based comparison.

Apply the proved Mathlib Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' to this germ and the zero germ, obtaining W, g:W -> V and a lift w in the comap fibre with F(g)(s)=0. Project the geometric lift through pullback.fst. The equality of lifts and Hom.etale_map_left_comp_fst show that the resulting point z of W maps to a(t), using algClosurePoint_base. Thus every t has an etale neighbourhood g_t:W_t -> V with a(t) in its image and s zero on W_t.

Each g_t is etale and has open image O_t. Let U be the union of these open images, indexed by the underlying set of T. Factor each g_t uniquely through the open immersion U -> V using IsOpenImmersion.lift, giving q_t:W_t -> U. The q_t are jointly surjective because U is their union of images, so Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff makes them an etale cover. The section restricted to U becomes zero on every W_t by functoriality and q_t followed by U -> V = g_t. Apply Sheaf.isSeparated to the sieve generated by this cover; zero is preserved by each restriction map. Hence s is zero on U. Every a(t) belongs to O_t, hence to U. If T is empty, U is the empty union and the same separatedness argument uses the empty cover.

proof_origin.place: Definition 59.29.6 and Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback) (3), general-site route through Sites Tag 05V1. G2 Lean proof uses the proved comap germ formula and descends simultaneously on the union of the pointed-neighbourhood images.
